measurement.mount: framework mount, framework tick, and layout read with scripts and CSS already loaded
measurement.update: all batches together, including framework tick and layout read
measurement.excluded: dependency installation, bundling, network transfer, and initial script parsing
measurement.freshValues: every row in every frame receives a distinct width; fresh cases use fewer batches
measurement.nativeTheme: static CSS from the same lightTheme token/value tree, prepared before timing
measurement.records: per-instance emitted rules; preloaded native, UnoCSS, and vanilla-extract CSS is excluded
measurement.compilerScope: same-SFC createStyles/useCss direct bindings only; imported project hooks conservatively use runtime
measurement.factoryScope: generated components invoke createStyles once per component setup; mount time includes this call
measurement.compilerDiagnostics: compiler-paths.json records autoRequested, prepared, binding, and runtimeFallback per case
